scripts.dev: npm run build:runtime && npm run dev -w editor
scripts.dev:all: npm run build:runtime && concurrently -n demo,editor -c cyan,green "npm run dev:demo" "npm run dev"
scripts.build:editor: npm run build:runtime && npm run build -w editor
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ve/core && npm run build:runtime && npm run build -w @ve/nlp && npm run build -w @ve/code-engine && npm run build -w editor && npm run build -w demo-app
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ve/core && npm run typecheck -w @ve/nlp && npm run typecheck -w @ve/code-engine
